request.query: A finite image of a finite set is finite

items.name: Finite.Set.finite_replacement
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Finite α] (f : α → β), Finite ↑{x | ∃ x_1, f x_1 = x}

items.name: Finite.Set.finite_image
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (s : Set α) (f : α → β) [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f '' s)

items.name: Finite.Set.finite_range
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} (f : ι → α) [Finite ι], Finite ↑(Set.range f)

items.name: Set.fintypeMap
items.type: {α β : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq β] → (s : Set α) → (f : α → β) → [Fintype ↑s] → Fintype ↑(f <$> s)

items.name: Set.fintypeImage
items.type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [DecidableEq β] → (s : Set α) → (f : α → β) → [Fintype ↑s] → Fintype ↑(f '' s)
